sources.note: "5 MB (base64-encoded) on Amazon Bedrock and Google Cloud." Fitifact uses 5000000 base64 characters, the smaller reading of MB. JPEG, PNG, GIF, and WebP; at most 8000x8000 px. A request with more than 20 images lowers every image's limit to 2000 px per side, which this one-image profile does not model.

File types: PNG, JPEG, WEBP, and non-animated GIF; "Up to 512 MB total payload per request". The cap covers the whole request, so a base64 image must fit under it with room for the rest. Fitifact keeps only the first frame of an animated GIF, with consent. Pixel limits depend on the model and detail level and are applied by resizing, so this profile does not flatten them.

"Files can be up to 25 MB. Supported input formats are mp3, mp4, mpeg, mpga, m4a, wav, and webm." Fitifact uses 25000000 bytes, the smaller reading of MB, and reads m4a as MP4 and mpga as MP3. MPEG program streams are not modeled, so Fitifact refuses them rather than guess.
